scientific_question: Does the QK-only functional-LWT boundary that is practically tied with dense Muon at 350M/5TPP remain within the 0.02 CE dense-equivalence band at the selected 20TPP horizon?

theory_synthesis.paper_mechanism: Use layer/target-wise charts when parameter families occupy different functional manifolds; do not force V/O residual writes or the MLP into the simpler Q/K score-map chart.
theory_synthesis.causal_boundary: At 124M, QK-only isolated generated V as the remaining attention penalty. At 350M/5TPP, generating only headwise Q/K reached validation CE 3.0304, practically tied with historical dense 3.0317 and 0.1749 CE better than full-attention replacement.
theory_synthesis.optimizer_resolution: The 350M top-two confirmation selected LR 2.4e-3 by 0.0341 terminal validation CE, outside the preregistered 0.02 tie band; no LR, capacity, rank, seed, or optimizer sweep remains unresolved.
theory_synthesis.horizon_discriminator: A from-scratch 20TPP replay that changes only schedule length tests whether the accepted chart tracks the useful Q/K manifold for a longer path. Model scale is held at 350M so a failure cannot be attributed to simultaneous width/depth transfer.
theory_synthesis.architecture_boundary: Generate only attn.c_attn.qk_headwise with QK64 bilateral/output Cayley and output gain. Keep V, attention c_proj, c_fc, and MLP c_proj dense and Muon-trained.

dense_20tpp_reference.status: matched historical dense Muon endpoint; original Y400 artifact unavailable on PRO6

candidate.qk_recipe: Exact inherited QK64 bilateral Cayley, output-side Cayley, output gain, scale 1.0, Cayley subgroup LR scale 10/3, and fixed seeds.
candidate.frozen_training: From-scratch model/data seeds, LR 2.4e-3, minimum LR 2.4e-4, Muon/AdamW ownership, batch 32 x accumulation 8, dataset manifest, weight decay, fixed validation windows, and eager BF16 execution are unchanged from the selected 5TPP parent.

resource_admission.reclaim_policy: Remove only the three terminal 0.5TPP screen ckpt.pt files after their SHA-256 values match already committed immutable result artifacts. Preserve logs, status, provenance, checkpoint metadata, rankings, both 5TPP checkpoints, and all manifold trajectories.

decision_rule.pass_dense_closure: Accept QK-only functional LWT as the 350M/20TPP attention endpoint only if terminal validation CE is at most 2.8127. This authorizes a separate 690M preregistration, not an automatic launch.
decision_rule.partial_recovery: If terminal CE beats 2.9363 but exceeds 2.8127, record the exact improvement over full attention and residual gap to dense; do not claim closure or automatically promote.
decision_rule.fail: If terminal CE is not better than 2.9363, reject long-horizon transfer of the 5TPP closure and launch no capacity, LR, seed, or larger-model sweep.
